name: Linde India Ltd
about: Linde India Limited, a subsidiary of BOC Group,UK (owns 75% stake in the co), is primarily engaged in manufacture of industrial and medical gases and construction of cryogenic and non cryogenic air separation plants.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments:[1] a) Gases, Related Products & Services (78% in Q1 FY27 vs 87% in Q1 FY26):[2] The company supplies industrial and specialty gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, and argon through onsite pipeline systems, bulk liquid distribution networks, and packaged gas solutions. Its healthcare portfolio caters to hospitals and healthcare providers by offering medical gases and associated solutions. b) Project Engineering Division (22% in Q1 FY26 vs 13% in Q1 FY26):[3] The company offers turnkey engineering solutions for cryogenic gases, including the design, supply, installation, and commissioning of medium- to large-sized Air Separation Units (ASUs), nitrogen plants, and gas distribution networks. The division also manufactures cryogenic equipment such as distillation columns, cold boxes, cryogenic vessels, and vaporizers for both internal use and external customers.
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 21.6%
cons: Stock is trading at 13.4 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.0% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
